notes_for_editor: Coordinates conflict for the same register number US 1563, OH 9: the register gives 40.095139, -81.664278 and the association list gives 40.09511, -81.54984 (the record's conflict note calls them 9,734 m apart). The Wikipedia infobox gives the park's centre as 40 06 09 N, 81 31 44 W, which does not settle which point is the tower. Neither point is verified on a map. A human should check before the location is changed. No build year, design, staffing or site description was found. A Salt Fork Lake history page had no tower content, and an ODNR Salt Fork Wildlife Area page could not be fetched (404).
